description: Make an instant voice clone of a real person from one to five clips already in your library. What makes a good sample: one person talking and nobody else, no music and no background noise, normal speaking tone, and about a minute or more of talking across the clips you send. Pass each clip as an asset id from the library or an https link. The clone takes one voice slot on the account and is ready in seconds; it comes back as a voice_id you can speak with straight away, and it is saved in the voice list. Only clone a voice you have the person's permission to clone: that permission is yours to get, not ours to assume, and a public figure's voice always needs their clearance. Costs tokens (a charge applies). Returns voice_id and name.

description.description: Optional. How this voice sounds, so it is easy to find later.

name.description: What to call this voice in the library, e.g. "Yani" or "Narrator, warm".

recordings.description: 1 to 5 clips of the person talking: asset ids from the library, or https links. Clean, one speaker, no music.

remove_background_noise.description: Optional. true cleans hiss and room noise off the clips before the clone is made.

tags.description: Optional labels for grouping voices, e.g. ["narrator","english"].

name: clone_voice
title: Clone Voice
